sources.title: Fine-Tune Qwen35 with 5GB VRAM | Michael Gold
sources.snippet: The post introduces a method to fine-tune the Qwen3.5 language model using a free notebook, requiring only 5GB of VRAM. This approach leverages the UnslOTH framework, which enhances training efficiency by enabling models to run 1.5x faster with reduced VRAM usage. The process is supported by GitHub repositories and guides, making it accessible for developers aiming to customize Qwen3.5 models.
